text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume family...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Namely, a group that passes down<n>assets and
knowledge among their<n>members, and whose
sense of unity<n>is much stronger than that of a
human<n>family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Great cultural value is placed on them,<n>especially in
Europe... I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl eagerly reads<n>through the book
she had picked up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I see... so the place I aim to compete<n>in also places
high emphasis on the<n>idea of family. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I want to defeat European racers,<n>then I need to
get to know more<n>families! I've no choice but to
ask<n>them for information directly!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you tell me about the<n>most
well-known families in the<n>Umamusume world?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At her request, I start to name a few...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First up is the Mejiro family. They're<n>one of the
most prestigious families<n>and are known for
celebrating the<n>individuality of their members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Satono Group. They are a<n>newly
emerging family, and every<n>Umamusume of the
Satono name<n>adheres to their philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiros and the Satonos... I<n>know about both
of them, of course.<n>But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to know about a family that's<n>more closed
off. You know, like one<n>that's more extreme and all
about<n>sticking to tradition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel a family like that would make it<n>easier to see
their real essence. Are<n>there any like that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...There is, but I don't think it will be<n>easy to
communicate with the family<n>I'm thinking of, so I
hesitate to tell<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But regardless of my reservations, it<n>doesn't
change the fact that there is,<n>indeed, a family that
matches what<n>Seeking the Pearl is looking for.
choice_data_list:
I suppose there's the most prestigious of
households...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The most prestigious of households?
choice_data_list: Yeah. They're a very strict and traditional family.
Yeah. They're a very strict and traditional family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're an old and noble family<n>known not only in
racing world, but<n>also in the political and financial
worlds as well. Their dignity is as<n>lofty as their
social standing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As such, insider information about<n>them is very
difficult to come by. The<n>only Umamusume from that
family<n>who's currently enrolled at Tracen<n>Academy
is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby, huh? I see...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've never really talked to her much,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll use this opportunity to get her to<n>spill her
family's secrets to me! Wish<n>me luck!
choice_data_list:
Huh? But I have a feeling she's gonna turn you
down...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing for you to worry<n>about! I've got a
secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A noble family like that will surely turn<n>her away at
first glance. What kind of<n>secret plan does Seeking
the Pearl<n>have that can get around that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ruby! There's something I<n>wanna talk to you
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl pays no heed to the<n>forbidding
aura that surrounds Daiichi<n>Ruby and walks straight
up to her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell me everything about the<n>most
prestigious of households that<n>you belong to?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's just all so fascinating that I find<n>myself
incredibly interested in it!<n>Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see. Her "secret plan" was just to<n>walk up to
Daiichi Ruby and ask her<n>for information without
preamble. In<n>response to that...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall tell you everything about our<n>house.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure it's okay to share your family's
secrets?

Are you sure it's okay to share your family's
secrets?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Secrets?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We don't have any secrets. It's<n>simply that no
Umamusume has ever<n>approached me to ask about
my<n>family before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the reason why so little is<n>known about
her family is because<n>her noble aura scared off
anyone<n>who wanted to get near her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, Daiichi Ruby invites<n>us to a private
room, and I take a<n>closer look at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby is a refined Umamusume<n>who belongs
to the most prestigious<n>of households.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her house's influence extends<n>everywhere, and
there's not a single<n>person inside or outside of the
Umamusume world who doesn't<n>know of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both her mother and grandmother<n>were famous
Umamusume who<n>walked on the well-trodden path
of<n>the Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Ruby herself is the glorious<n>successor to this
renowned family.<n>Her own aura is palpable in its
own<n>right.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So Ruby, what does your house mean<n>to you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And are you nothing more than a<n>yes-Uma to your
family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What I want to ask is whether you're<n>a puppet
being controlled by your<n>family, or if you're the
puppeteer<n>who's using them for your own<n>gains.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, which of you is the<n>master, and
which is the servant?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hmm, if that is your query, then...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We are neither master nor servant.<n>My house and I
are as one.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Stand ever glorious, ever<n>supreme—and always
shine the<n>brightest."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have embraced this maxim of ours<n>my entire life,
and I work hard every<n>day aspiring to meet it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My family's dreams, obligations, and<n>privileges are
one and the same with<n>my own. There is no
separation<n>between us.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume born into the<n>family strives for
the top as an<n>individual bearing our family legacy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is what it means to be a part of<n>our house.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Our superiority is absolute. There are<n>no hierarchies,
nor master and<n>servant dynamics in our family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your superiority is absolute...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So that's what the epitome of a<n>traditional
Umamusume family is like...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She's unbelievably strong, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's countenance is<n>filled with deep
anxiety on the way<n>home after their talk.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't obey her family because<n>she has to.
She does so because she<n>sees it as her destiny to
have been<n>born into that house...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And they work together seamlesslyas one without distinction from oneanother... Well, I guess that family ispretty extreme, though.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And since they're backed up by all<n>that
accumulated wealth and<n>knowledge, it's no wonder
they're<n>powerful.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is what an Umamusume family<n>is, and what I'll
one day have to face<n>off against in Europe...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But first, my matchup against the<n>Mejiros is right
around the corner...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given the huge challenge awaiting<n>her in the
upcoming Hanshin Juvenile<n>Fillies, I'm not
surprised that Seeking<n>the Pearl is getting a little
worried.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But still!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's no reason to give up, right,<n>Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Giving in to a strong Umamusume<n>family would be
like...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Accepting a world where they win<n>every race! And
there's no way I can<n>do that!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I stand for potential! I must show theworld that everyone has thepossibility to succeed, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And in order to do that, I first have to<n>confront the
Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive in front of the station<n>entrance, the both
of us still lost in<n>thought. There, we see...

text_block_list.name: Volunteer
text_block_list.text:
Please consider donating to<n>underprivileged
children!

text_block_list.name: Volunteers
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fundraising... Haha, how<n>wonderful that they
have the heart to<n>reach out and aid people they
don't<n>even know...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They're willing to invest so much<n>time and energy
into helping them,<n>even though they're not family...
That's true kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has a point... Umamusume<n>families aren't the
only people who<n>share bonds with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bonds exist between all people,<n>however tenuous
they may be.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad we saw these volunteers.<n>Let's head
back to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I may not have family there, but that<n>doesn't mean
I don't share bonds<n>with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even though we don't share familial<n>blood, there
are still people who share<n>the same dream as me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I do! However small a grain of<n>sand may be
at the beginning...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It'll grow bigger and bigger as layers<n>are added to
it, until it finally becomes<n>a brilliant pearl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so our days of intensive training<n>begin. We
only have two weeks until<n>the race, so we put all of
our effort in<n>to make the most of our time.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Believe in me, Trainer! And make me<n>believe in you
as well!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And then, let's show everyone just<n>how much
potential Umamusume who<n>aren't part of a family
can still have!
